description: Manually curated evaluation dataset for the real-world benchmark on Textualize/rich v14.3.4. Each query is a natural-language developer question; relevant_files are the repository-relative files (relative to the rich repo root) that implement the answer. Ground truth was established by reading the source of the pinned release, not by search results.

cases.name: terminal-output
cases.query: How is console output written to the terminal?

cases.name: ansi-escape-handling
cases.query: Where is ANSI escape sequence handling implemented?

cases.name: color-parsing
cases.query: How are colors parsed and converted to ANSI codes?

cases.name: syntax-highlighting
cases.query: Where is syntax highlighting implemented for code listings?

cases.name: theme-loading
cases.query: How are themes loaded and applied to styles?

cases.name: progress-bars
cases.query: Where is the progress bar rendering implemented?

cases.name: markup-parsing
cases.query: How does the console markup tag parser work?

cases.name: table-rendering
cases.query: Where is table layout and rendering implemented?

cases.name: python-logging

cases.name: terminal-prompts
cases.query: How are interactive terminal prompts implemented?

cases.name: live-display

cases.query: Where is the status spinner animation implemented?
